messages.text: Hey. Sarah's friend. Need to ask you something and I need the truth.
Jessica, right? Sarah talks about you constantly. What's up?
What are your intentions with her? Because if you're just looking for a work-wife to entertain you between product sprints, I will END you.
Whoa. Okay. Deep breath. I am divorced, in therapy, and absolutely not looking for entertainment. I care about her. A lot.
She's fragile right now. Derek has worn her down to nothing. If you add to that damage, I swear to god—
I want to BUILD her back up. Not take pieces. I'm not him.
...okay. You're on probation. But I'm watching.
Fair. Can I ask you something? How do I help her without making her feel rescued?
Treat her like she's already whole. She just forgot.
She's at my place. Derek threatened to post about the accident.
I'm getting the lawyer. And my cousin who does digital security. If Derek posts anything we nuke it from orbit.
She won't let me call the police. She says he's 'not well.'
He's well enough to manipulate her. She's been gaslit so long she thinks HIS pain is HER fault. Classic trauma bonding.
How do I get her to see it?
You can't. She has to see it herself. All you can do is be the safe place she comes back to when she does.
I'm scared I'll lose her to guilt before she gets there.
Me too, Marcus. Me too. But for the first time in years, she's CONSIDERING leaving. That's the first domino. Don't knock it over.
